Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

  • Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

  • Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

  • Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

  • Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

  • Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe, Identitäten und Erfahrungshorizonte.

Demand for sovereign European compute is not our constraint. Capacity is. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.

  • Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

  • Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

  • Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

  • Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

  • Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

  • Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

  • A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

  • You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers and vendors on power, cooling, networking and hardware

  • Strong programme management: you run complex projects with many parties against hard deadlines

  • Confidence negotiating and managing contracts with data centers, OEMs and suppliers

  • You have built and led teams from scratch and still go deep into the details yourself

  • Very high sense of urgency and ownership

  • You make good decisions fast with incomplete information and prefer momentum over perfection

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English, German is a plus. Willingness to travel across Europe

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Head of Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success to translate customer feedback into go-to-market opportunities.

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

We don't accept that.

We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

This position is remote within the EMEA region, with the flexibility to work from our Munich or Budapest office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About You:

  • You are customer focussed and and excited to partner with customers to identify and deliver measurable impact
  • You communicate clearly and effectively across levels, with people from the shop floor to engineering managers to c-level executives
  • You like to solve problems, working closely with colleagues from other departments
  • You have worked for or supported a Life Sciences company and understand their regulatory requirements
  • You have experience in life science development, operations and/or manufacturing environments
  • You Google your way out of most problems, and understand that every customer sees the world a bit differently

What skills do I need?

  • BA/BS (MBA/Masters preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Product Management, Management Consulting or other client-facing roles in the Life Sciences industry 
  • Experience with change management in a GxP manufacturing and operations
  • Experience creating and leading stakeholder & executive presentations, working with enterprise corporations and multicultural business environments
  • Experience coordinating and leading actions among cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services)
  • Bias for action and client impact
  • Passion for continuous improvement and digital transformation
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, technology-driven business environment
  • Ability to travel (estimated up to 15%)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts by monitoring their adoption, utilization and overall health of their deployment
  • Serve as internal customer champion
  • Guide customers to use Tulip as a tool to improve their operations through digitization, including recommending new use cases, tracking and communicating ROI
  • Act as a trusted partner to customers to ensure and manage contract renewals and support commercial expansion
  • Coordinate across internal teams, from Customer Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Sales
  • Build and improve internal processes and content, as mechanisms to scale up and mature the Customer Success function

Key Collaborators:

  • Customers
  • Professional Services
  • Customer Support 
  • Sales
  • Product Management
  • Tulip's partners, who may also be supporting an account

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. 

Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
  • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
  • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.

Role overview

Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete.

As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs.

What you’ll do

  • Own targeted remediation coordination. For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence.

  • Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions. Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions through the agreed governance route. The relevant delivery owner remains accountable for implementing the condition.

  • Coordinate enhanced oversight of merchants. Support a structured watch-list approach for merchants whose risk or control environment warrants closer attention than routine, risk-tiered monitoring, but where immediate termination or a formal investigation is not necessarily the right response. Help define the oversight plan, review progress and ensure concerns do not remain unresolved or without an owner.

  • Assess remediation quality. Review proposed actions and evidence against the underlying financial crime concern and relevant regulatory expectations. Identify whether controls appear appropriately designed and operating, whether further evidence or testing is needed, and whether residual concerns require escalation or a change in the relationship’s risk treatment.

  • Engage merchants constructively. Where appropriate, work with account teams to agree clear requests, expectations and timelines with merchants. Maintain a firm, evidence-led approach while supporting a proportionate path to address weaknesses and establish whether the relationship can be sustained safely.

  • Lead enhanced control reviews. Design and, where appropriate, lead deeper reviews of a merchant’s AML controls during onboarding or ongoing oversight. This may include preparing agendas, conducting structured discussions with merchant stakeholders, probing key control areas, documenting findings and agreeing any required remediation.

  • Support reliance and outsourcing assessments. Contribute to the initial scrutiny of outsourced activities or other arrangements that depend on another party’s controls. Help establish whether reliance is justified, what evidence supports that view, and what conditions or remediation are required.

  • Improve the oversight approach. Capture recurring issues, lessons and delivery gaps, and help refine processes, reporting and escalation so that complex concerns receive consistent, timely and well-evidenced attention.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or a closely related risk and control role, with a sound understanding of AML control frameworks and how to assess their design and effectiveness.

  • Experience coordinating complex remediation, regulatory or audit actions, control reviews, investigations follow-through, or comparable cross-functional change. You can turn an ambiguous issue into a sequenced plan with clear owners, milestones and evidence of completion.

  • The confidence and judgement to challenge senior stakeholders and merchants constructively, distinguish a credible response from a paper commitment, and escalate when progress or evidence is inadequate.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to lead structured discussions, document findings clearly and translate complex issues into practical actions.

  • Excellent organisation and follow-through across multiple workstreams, with a pragmatic approach to prioritisation, dependencies and changing circumstances.

  • A collaborative style and the resilience to work through sensitive, commercially significant issues without losing sight of the control outcome.

  • Experience with structured project management methods, such as Lean Six Sigma or PRINCE2, to drive organised execution across complex workstreams is a strong plus.

Experience with complex merchants, payments, cryptoassets, money service businesses, correspondent or outsourced service models would be valuable. Relevant professional qualifications are welcome but are not a substitute for sound judgement and demonstrated delivery.

Why this role

You will work at the point where financial crime risk, merchant relationships and practical execution meet. The role offers meaningful ownership of issues that cut across teams and can shape whether concerns are resolved early, managed with appropriate safeguards, or escalated on a sound evidential basis. Success is visible in the quality of the decisions and the fact that agreed actions are actually completed.

BODYPUMP und ZUMBA.

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum

  • Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln

  • Du sorgst idealerweise selbstständig für deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit bei Bedarf selbst als Stellvertretung einzuspringen

  • Du hast das Interesse und die Möglichkeit zukünftig mehrere Lektionen pro Woche an verschiedenen Wochentagen und/oder in verschiedenen Studios zu übernehmen

  • Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse


Was wir dir bieten:

  • Wir sind ein junges, dynamisches und internationales Team 

  • Wir bezahlen ein branchengerechtes Salär

  • Wir bieten dir gratis Training in all unseren Studios

We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

    Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

    At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

    1. Physical/embedded device security. 

    1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

    1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

    1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

    What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

    As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

    What you will be doing 

    As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

     As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

    • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

    • Security architecture review process 

    • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation

    About the role.

    We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations.     When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively.     • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

    • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

    • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

    • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

    • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

    • Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.



    How you make your mark.

    • Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

    • Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

    • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

    • Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

    • Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.



    What you bring to the team.

    • Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

    • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

    • Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

    • Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

    • Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

    • Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.



    What sets you apart.

    • Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

    • Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.

Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers.     Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

    • Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

    • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

    • Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren;

    • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

    • Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek;

    • Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

    • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

    • Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen;

    • De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus.

    Wat je gaat doen

    Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

    Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

    • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

    • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

    • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

    • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

    • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

    • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

    • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

    • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

    Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


    Wat neem je mee?

    Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

    Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

    • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

    • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

    • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

    • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

    • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

    • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

    • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

    Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

", "company_logo_url": "https://remotive.com/job/2091161/logo"}, {"id": 2091158, "url": "https://remotive.com/remote-jobs/software-development/software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-2091158", "title": "Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks", "company_name": "Askable", "company_logo": "https://remotive.com/job/2091158/logo", "category": "Software Development", "tags": ["C++", "docker", "git", "go", "java", "python", "security", "AI/ML", "rust", "Typescript ", "distributed systems", "SOLID", "Linux/Unix", "testing", "infrastructure"], "job_type": "contract", "publication_date": "2026-10-17T16:04:29", "candidate_required_location": "Worldwide", "salary": "$1000 per task", "description": "

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care
  • Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans
  • Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner
  • Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Choose between 32 or 40 hours per week, with the ability to structure your schedule in a way that works best for you and your patients
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 hours): A condensed schedule option designed to support balance, energy, and sustainability
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) (after 90 days)
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.

  • Translate business processes and requirements into technical requirements & design documentation, solution design, and system configurations to support the client’s desired to-be state

What You Bring

Nice-to-haves

Our Hiring Process

Job Description

Summarized Purpose:

Acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and interdepartmental and client liaison for data analytics activities.

This is not an entry-level or general admin role. The ideal candidate already understands how workers' compensation litigation works and can get a case fully prepared for the attorney to argue, including making appearances on the attorney's behalf short of trial itself.

This is intended to be a long-term engagement. Because of the learning curve involved in understanding Minnesota workers' compensation law and the firm's internal processes, the firm is not looking to repeat this training with frequent turnover.   • Ensure every case meets the proper medical-legal standards required to win in front of a judge or in settlement.
  • Make appearances on behalf of the attorney as needed throughout the case lifecycle.
  • Work under the direct supervision of, and in close coordination with, Attorney Mark Rodgers and Attorney Jim Perkett.

Required

  • Case files fully prepared for the attorney to argue.
  • Accurate, complete case pictures built from medical records and client accounts.
  • Reliable appearances and follow-through on the attorney's behalf.
  • Long-term commitment and low turnover.

Why Join Us

You'll join a collaborative, fully remote team that values ownership, professionalism, clear communication, and long-term commitment, working side by side with experienced attorneys.

About Lydian Energy

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America.  Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing.  Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

Job Scope

The Senior Project Manager carries overall accountability for safety, scope, schedule, cost, and quality across a portfolio of complex, high-value renewable energy projects. This role functions as the primary interface with internal stakeholders, utilities, system operators, regulatory entities, equipment suppliers, and EPC contractors. High collaboration skills are essential: the role requires working effectively across accounting, finance, legal, commercial, and operations/asset management, in addition to external partners, and the ability to build strong working relationships across all of these groups.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of independently delivering large-scale solar PV and/or BESS projects from development through commissioning, with the judgment to navigate complexity and the presence to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment. This is a full-ownership role: the successful candidate takes projects from construction through completion rather than a single phase of the work.

Key Responsibilities include:

Development:

  • Lead preparation and senior review of CAPEX and OPEX cost estimates for solar and BESS projects, providing sign-off quality analysis for investment committee submissions.
  • Own project schedules, budgets, cashflow models, and reporting packages; ensure accuracy and completeness across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Drive the RFP process for EPC contractors, including evaluation of proposals and lead negotiation of contracts, with accountability for final commercial terms.
  • Serve as a senior relationship owner with internal and external partners, equipment suppliers, utilities, and project host communities.

EPC Project Execution:

  • Accountable for delivering complex, multi-site energy storage and solar projects within approved budgets and schedules, escalating risks with recommended mitigations.
  • Lead strategic sourcing and manage the full RFP/RFQ cycle for engineering services, equipment and material procurement, and construction contracts.
  • Drive bid evaluations, review contract terms and conditions in coordination with legal, and own contract negotiations through close.
  • Chair weekly project meetings; maintain action item registers, prepare meeting minutes, manage RFIs, track issues, and document lessons learned.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules in coordination with EPC contractors; proactively identify and communicate schedule risks.
  • Own change management processes, including review of scope modifications and approval of contractor invoices.
  • Coordinate across a broad set of internal and external stakeholders including leadership, project team members, utilities, AHJs, professional services, EPC contractors, and equipment suppliers.
  • Directly manage at least one full-time, site-based construction manager or construction engineer per project (contract staff), while holding indirect accountability for all contractors and vendors performing project work; on larger or multi-phase projects, this may include additional direct reports.
  • Work across the broader organization, including accounting, finance, legal, and the commercial team, and coordinate with operations and asset management on project handoff at completion.
  • Responsible for monitoring of construction quality to ensure that all work is installed in accordance with the plans, specifications, QA/QC requirements, code requirements, contract requirements and good construction practices.
  • Responsible for the Safety and Environmental compliance of the Lydian’s personnel and subcontractors during construction in accordance with federal, state and local laws, and Lydian policies, practices and procedures. Ensure all personnel and subcontractors meet technical and safety training requirements.
  • Own project reporting to senior management, including schedule, budget, and risk status across the portfolio.
  • Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to junior Project Managers as the team grows.

Qualifications

  • Solar PV and/or BESS experience is strongly preferred; strong utility-scale wind background will also be considered. "Utility-scale" is defined as projects of 100 MW or greater.
  • Engineering background strongly preferred. Candidates with electrical engineering backgrounds from conventional power plants (gas, coal, nuclear) are also of strong interest.
  • 8-10 years of project management experience in the energy sector, including direct responsibility for utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS project delivery (strong utility-scale wind experience also considered). Demonstrated experience leading roughly half a dozen utility-scale projects from construction through completion, reflecting the pace of renewable project cycles.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering projects exceeding $200M in total installed cost, on schedule and within budget.
  • Expert-level proficiency in project scheduling software (Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or equivalent); advanced use of the Microsoft 365 suite (Project, SharePoint, Teams, Excel).
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience negotiating EPC and procurement contracts and managing contractor performance.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced development environment.
  • High collaboration skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across accounting, finance, legal, commercial, and operations/asset management.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and written communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level reporting.
  • Experience developing and maintaining project KPIs, operational metrics, and management dashboards.
  • Safety certifications required (OSHA 30 or equivalent) preferred.
  • PMP certification is a plus but not required.
  • Travel required approximately every other week to project sites (typically 2-4 days per trip, depending on project needs), plus a quarterly all-team offsite.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to equal-employment principles and are dedicated to diversity and the strength it brings to the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, military status, sexual orientation or any other protected category or class that may be applicable.

Position Summary


The Business Development Leader (BDL) serves as the face of the entire Coverys organization, representing all Coverys capabilities in their assigned territories and/or distributors. The BDL is responsible for upholding the Company’s core values and promoting our current and future growth, profitability, and business diversification objectives. Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Territorial Ownership –
    • Plan strategically for their territory and collaboratively deploys company resources to maximize production. The BDL is seen and acts as the chief decision-maker and “go-to” company leader for his/her assigned territories as respects regional distribution management and market opportunities.
    • Seek higher level approvals when required, but always demonstrates strong business judgement & critical thinking in driving profitable growth, solving regional challenges and supporting key business units and functional areas.
    • Assist in successfully managing those opportunities in collaboration with colleagues, especially when market opportunities span territories or are multi-regional.
  • Producer Engagement
    • Proactively build and maintain valuable and profitable producer relationships.
    • Hold distributors accountable in meeting defined expectations and objectives.
    • Utilize qualitative and quantitative capabilities to measure overall performance and assess distributor potential.
    • Recognize producer successes and addresses agency shortfalls in a transparent manner. Conduct periodic, productive and agenda driven meetings with producers in the territories, both in person and through on-line virtual meetings.
  • Education and Communication
    • Demonstrate a confidence and willingness to consistently learn. Build and cultivates a deep knowledge of all Coverys product and service capabilities, including competitive differentiators
    • Educate agents, prospects and insureds about Coverys’ diverse customer services and capabilities in both its core and emerging markets. Discover and understand customer and distributor needs and confidently offers custom solutions in a situational response environment, relying heavily on effective use of internal business units and their subject matter experts (SMEs).
    • Develop effective intra-departmental communication strategies to support key business units and to keep pace with Coverys’ rapid product development and organizational expansion.
  • Account & Pipeline Management
    • Identify, develop, capture and maintain information on viable facility and provider groups matching underwriting appetites within their assigned territory. Use such knowledge to develop a deep and authoritative understanding of target and existing customers, their distributors and competitors.
    • Utilize such intelligence and account specific selling strategies to build and manage a pipeline of target accounts responsibilities (new business and renewal).
  • Sales Call Effectiveness
    • Conduct highly effective sales calls, both live and virtual environments, with producers by establishing mutually agreed upon meeting objectives/agendas.
    • Ensure effective use of each party’s time, generate meaningful outcomes from meetings, and follow through on all post meeting commitments including proper documentation.
  • Team Leadership
    • Ensure SMEs and other internal staff are well-coordinated and accountable for delivery on target and existing customers, and distributors.

Education, Experience, Competencies & Values

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent education is strongly preferred

  • Active P&C Producer’s License is a plus, but not required.
  • Skills needed: Consultative Selling, Complex Selling Strategy, Relationship Building, Communication & Interpersonal Skills (internal/external, written/verbal), Professionally Demanding, Attention to Detail/Documentation, Strategic/Analytical Interpretation, Technological Adaptation.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office. Proficiency with MS Excel (including filters & pivot tables) and PowerPoint (create and/or modify slide-based presentations).
  • Experience with Salesforce is preferred.
  • Excellent tactical execution is required in support of their territorial strategy.
  • Travel Up to 50%, primarily for key distributor/client meetings (including events) and some HO required travel.

Base salary range is $109,345 - $128,640. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

Levi's is seeking a visionary User Experience Design leader to shape the future of technology across our global retail, e-commerce, and internal platforms. This role sets the UX strategy, champions end-user needs, and partners closely with product, engineering, merchandising, marketing, and brand creative teams. Leading a team of 12 (two group managers and 10 designers), you'll drive design excellence, influence product roadmaps, align senior leaders around innovative ideas, and collaborate across regions and functions. You'll also help redefine how work gets done at Levi's by integrating AI into the design process. This role can be based anywhere in the US and reports to the VP, Product Management & User Experience.


About the Job

  • Provide the vision to transform user experience across the entire ecosystem of Levi's products and services
  • Champion design thinking and UX best practices across the organization
  • Set and maintain design quality standards, including critique, design reviews, and the design system, so great work scales across channels and regions
  • Tie design work to business results, such as conversion and retention in consumer channels and adoption and productivity in internal tools, and use those measures to set priorities
