      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

</description>

      <title>Doximity: Commercial Data Scientist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Legal Ops</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC or Remote (EST or CST)
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops</a></p>

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

","id":"2a55d6c9-c564-443a-be3e-a3851db5a93b","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

"},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

"},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

This role is based in New York City

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

    The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We’re behind the technology that thousands of Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning devices, identity and access, networking, IT support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity platforms, work management tooling, and AI tooling.

    We’re looking for an AV Engineer II to join the IT Studio in Stockholm and help create reliable, intuitive AV experiences across our office. You’ll own everything from everyday meeting-room technology to high-stakes executive meetings, partnering with our global AV team, IT Support, NetOps, other technical teams, and external vendors.

    ","id":"785989a6-b219-43b1-92d9-750a67054f24","lists":[{"text":"What You’ll Do","content":"
  • Own the AV experience across EMEA, including meeting rooms, boardrooms, common areas, labs, lounges, and digital signage.
  • Provide thoughtful, high-quality AV support for executive and VIP meetings, helping ensure technology works reliably when it matters most.
  • Design, document, deliver, and maintain AV solutions and technical standards in partnership with the global AV team. Review technical designs and documentation from external integrators to ensure solutions meet requirements.
  • Lead AV initiatives and projects with internal partners and external vendors, from defining scope through delivery, commissioning, and handover.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex AV issues and support incident, problem, and change management when needed.
  • Monitor AV infrastructure and performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and test new solutions that make collaboration easier for team members.
  • Deploy and support AI-powered capabilities across meeting rooms and video conferencing, while using AI tooling to improve areas such as monitoring, reporting, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain AV asset information, contribute to forecasting and budgeting, and create clear technical documentation and training materials.
  • Build strong relationships with vendors, integrators, and internal partners while identifying better ways of working across the team.
  • Share your knowledge with colleagues, support the onboarding of new team members, and continue developing your own AV expertise.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have 3+ years of AV experience and have delivered AV projects through design, integration, commissioning, and ongoing support.
  • You understand the hardware behind sophisticated AV systems, including DSP, control processors, amplifiers, and related technologies, with experience using platforms such as Crestron, Q-SYS, and Dante. Experience configuring Q-SYS designs is a plus, as are certifications such as AVIXA CTS, Q-SYS Level 2, or Dante Level 3.
  • You have hands-on experience deploying, managing, and monitoring video conferencing systems such as Google Meet hardware and Zoom Rooms. You're familiar with fleet management and monitoring tools and can troubleshoot issues across connected AV systems.
  • You have experience supporting senior executives or VIPs and can provide thoughtful, professional, and discreet support when priorities are time-sensitive.
  • You understand IT and networking fundamentals, including how AV systems communicate across enterprise networks.
  • You're familiar with technologies such as Dante and Q-SYS, including multicast, QoS, and clocking, and have experience using ticketing or work-management systems such as Jira.

    LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.

    The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.

    We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

  • Keep the platform healthy: Take part in a weekly support rotation and shared on-call. You'll debug production issues that span storage formats, catalog APIs, Kubernetes reconciliation, GCP IAM and BigQuery internals, and you'll automate away recurring toil.

    • Lead, support, and develop a team of data and backend engineers, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and grow.

    • Work with product managers, business partners, and engineering teams to set priorities and build data products that improve the subscription experience.

    • Guide the development of reliable, scalable data pipelines and backend services that support targeting, messaging, personalisation, and machine learning.

    • Help your team make informed technical decisions, balancing data quality, reliability, business needs, and long-term maintainability.

    • Support engineers through regular feedback, coaching, career development, and opportunities to share knowledge.

    • Collaborate across teams to manage dependencies, solve challenges, and build shared data solutions.

    • Improve engineering practices, including service reliability, sustainable on-call processes, and responsible data management.

    • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and support your team's work.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have worked with large-scale data pipelines, data platforms, or backend services. Experience with technologies such as Google Cloud, BigQuery, Apache Beam, Dataflow, dbt, Flyte, Airflow, Scala, or Java is valuable.

    • You can navigate changing priorities, make informed decisions, and help your team move forward when the path isn't always clear.

    • You communicate clearly and build effective partnerships with product, business, and engineering teams to turn shared goals into practical solutions.

    • You value different perspectives, encourage open feedback, and help create an environment where people feel respected and supported.

    • You're curious about new technologies, including AI and automation, and enjoy finding ways to improve how teams work and deliver value.

    Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.

    We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.

    Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

    ","id":"25fac63d-d4ba-48b9-80b1-b8e87b55e448","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

    • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

    • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

    • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

    • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

    • You communicate creative ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating with designers, producers, and partners across different disciplines and regions.

    • You have experience working with external creative studios, production companies, and partners, including managing budgets, contracts, and production workflows.

    • You care about creating an inclusive, supportive team environment where different perspectives are valued, feedback is welcomed, and people can do their best work.

    "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

    Spotify's Legal team is growing. We're facing innovative challenges that mirror the groundbreaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we've expanded into more than 180 markets and our business has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day — including an increasing volume of patent disputes alongside the copyright and content matters that have always been central to our work.

    As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. The work we face is constantly developing, and the workload is growing faster than we can, so we will look to you to think thoughtfully about processes and policies that will help meet our goals. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial. Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

    ","id":"8d54dd6d-d7e0-4298-b051-423bcec4089e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You hold a law degree (or equivalent) from a top-flight law school and are qualified to practice law as in-house counsel in the State of New York.
  • You have 5+ years of litigation experience at a law firm, in-house, or both, including meaningful experience with copyright litigation.
  • You have experience with e-discovery and managing complex, multi-jurisdictional disputes.
  • You have experience contributing to teams that drive successful outcomes on complex matters.
  • You have a demonstrated ability to evaluate copyright claims, work with technical experts, and develop defense strategies.
  • You have a passion for solving legal problems and can explain legal concepts — including technical copyright issues — to non-lawyers.
  • You are comfortable working with large data sets and technical subject matter; you may not be an engineer, but you can speak the language and understand the concepts.
  • You are a problem solver who can stay calm when problems come your way.
  • You have excellent judgment — you can think a problem through when you need to, but have also developed instincts that you can trust.
  • You are self-motivated and can identify and complete work that needs to be done without being instructed.
  • You can advocate for a position while balancing risk and multiple colleagues' and business considerations.
  • You can balance many simultaneous tasks and triage to make sure the right matters get your attention.
  • You're willing to roll up your sleeves and dig in on projects.
  • You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal business partners.
  • You have very effective written and oral communication skills.
  • Knowledge of music, media, tech, IP, and/or consumer issues is a plus.
  • A technical background or experience with software, streaming, or audio technology patents is a plus but not required.

    At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

    Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

    We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

    Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

  • Prototype new approaches and productionise solutions at scale for our hundreds of millions of active users
  • Help drive optimisation, testing, and tooling to improve quality
  • Unblock and share context with your teammates to raise the whole squad's velocity
  • Use AI-assisted engineering to move faster and remove repetitive toil, while owning the quality of everything you ship
  • Partner closely with senior and staff ML engineers, and be part of an active group of machine learning practitioners in your mission and across Spotify

    We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artist & Label Partnerships Manager for France, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Paris. In this role, you will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.

     

    Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. 

     

    ","id":"d06fe312-4b91-4c40-a3da-64985b569075","lists":[{"text":"What You'll do ","content":"
     
  • Focusing on the French music landscape, you will be the primary point of contact for local music partners based in France, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform initiatives to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development
  • Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in France on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business
  • You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists development and artist-fan engagement
  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local FR team to execute pivotal initiatives, multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, consumer marketing, communications, strategy & operations…
  • Lead artist & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in France and use this to further Spotify's appeal to existing and new users
  • Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are ","content":"
  • You have significant experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. 
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in France and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community
  • You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify's role in the music industry both locally and globally
  • You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives
  • You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data

    Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

    As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.

    You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

    ","id":"66184cac-4d6c-46f6-868c-bac0c184fd22","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Own sales operations for Spotify Technology, including CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and account assignment, and deal desk processes.

    • Design and roll out a segmented sales model that evolves our go-to-market approach as the business matures.

    • Build infrastructure and systems to support a scalable Commercial sales motion (companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), focused on faster deal cycles, efficient lead routing, and repeatable processes.

    • Build infrastructure and systems to support a strategic Enterprise sales motion (companies with 1,000+ employees), enabling prospecting, account planning, and multi-product engagements.

    • Partner with the Director of Sales as a strategic advisor on quota setting, capacity planning, compensation, territory design, and headcount modeling.

    • Support revenue across the full customer lifecycle, including new business, expansion, and retention.

    • Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time to close, forecast accuracy, and net revenue retention by segment.

    • Strengthen forecasting discipline and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline through effective reporting and sales processes.

    • Identify friction across the sales process, including handoffs between Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and drive improvements with cross-functional partners.

    • Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation reporting, lead management, and process improvements.

    • Establish and continuously improve operating rhythms, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), as the business scales.

    • Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 6+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market strategy, with a track record of meaningful impact at a senior level.

    • You have experience scaling sales operations through a startup or high-growth phase and understand when to introduce new processes and structure.

    • You can build systems and processes from the ground up without adding unnecessary complexity.

    • You are proficient in using AI and can lead initiatives that improve sales effectiveness through AI-enabled tools and processes.

    • You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within developer platforms, DevOps tools, or cloud services.

    • You understand the differences between product-led growth (PLG), Commercial, and Enterprise sales motions and have experience designing segmented sales models.

    • You understand complex technical sales involving Sales Engineering and recognize the importance of customer retention and post-sale success in revenue strategy.

    • You have hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, including building reports, workflows, and resolving data issues.

    • You use data to guide forecasting, capacity modeling, and funnel analysis, combining analytical skills with sound business judgment.

    • You can influence senior sales leaders, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions without formal authority.

    • You are comfortable working in evolving environments, adapting as priorities change, and helping shape how an innovative business grows.

    "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives, helping each seller grow their skills and consistently achieve or exceed their targets.

    • Own quarterly and annual team revenue targets for new business with organizations of 1,000+ employees, in partnership with the Director of Sales.

    • Translate Spotify Technology's overall sales strategy into a clear enterprise plan, including target accounts, territory priorities, and account planning standards.

    • Build a team that converts inbound demand while proactively hunting new opportunities in target accounts.

    • Stay hands-on in key deals, joining customer meetings, supporting negotiations, and helping navigate complex buying committees.

    • Coach the team on strategic account planning, multi-threading, champion building, and developing executive-level business cases.

    • Run a disciplined operating rhythm through regular pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and one-on-ones, while maintaining accurate forecasts and a healthy, predictable pipeline for long-cycle deals.

    • Partner with Revenue Operations on territory design, reporting, and process improvements for the Enterprise segment.

    • Collaborate with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and proofs of concept, with Customer Success on retention and expansion, and with Marketing on account-based programs and pipeline generation.

    • Help sellers articulate how Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

    • Help sellers tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

    • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

    • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and developing sales playbooks as the Enterprise team grows.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, including closing large, complex enterprise deals, and 3+ years of experience managing sales teams.

    • You are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting direction while staying involved in the details of individual deals.

    • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information and can coach your team to prioritize high-potential opportunities while confidently moving away from poorly qualified deals.

    • You have experience selling to engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams, or developer experience buyers, and understand how they evaluate and make purchasing decisions.

    • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

    • You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including procurement processes, security reviews, and multi-year agreements.

    • You have experience partnering closely with Sales Engineering and understand the importance of technical depth in complex enterprise sales.

    • You use data and metrics to guide forecasting, coaching, and decision-making, while building structure and processes without adding unnecessary complexity.

    • You bring strong communication, coaching, negotiation, and presentation skills.

    • You are excited to help build a scalable enterprise sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

     

    Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.

     

    You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.

     

    We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.

    ","id":"cb29d857-395b-401d-9749-367e666ff870","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.

    • Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.

    • Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.

    • Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.

    • Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.

    • Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.

    • Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.

    • Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.

    • Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

    • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work.

    • You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload.

    • You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path.

    • You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies.

    • You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable.

    • You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content.

    • You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

    • You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments.

    • You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.

    • You are excited to create and critically evaluate cutting-edge AI workflows for detection development, alert triage, security investigations, and response, while applying sound security judgment and appropriate human oversight.

    • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to strengthen security across devices, networks, and enterprise systems.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    Within Personalization, the Speak Team owns the development of Spotify's state-of-the-art speech models, contributing to speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech-to-speech models.     We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
     
    As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.

    We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

    Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

    ","id":"813b4b62-429c-42e9-a8f7-59e9412fb287","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do ","content":"
  • Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are ","content":"
  • You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.

  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

    We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

    You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

    ","id":"9d1c90b5-a8a4-4218-b2f3-7bbaefae7fd1","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
  • Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
  • Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
  • Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
  • Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
  • Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
  • Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
  • Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
  • Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
  • You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
  • You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
  • You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
  • You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
  • You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
  • You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
  • You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
  • You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
  • You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

    As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

     
    ","id":"c3f6ea23-97d0-4a9a-a9ad-04f1e745d916","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

    As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe.     Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks.

You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.

    As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

    ","id":"281e7db9-86ba-4a1c-8773-c23b96ed32dc","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

    • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

    • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

    • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

    • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

    • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

    • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

    • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

    • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

    • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

    • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

    • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

    • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

    • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

    • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

    • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

    • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

    • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

    • Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.
    • Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.
    • Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.
    • Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.
    • Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.
    • Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.
    • Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.

  • Collaborate with teams across Spotify, including Legal, Communications, Social Impact, Product, Compliance, and Trust & Safety, to understand business priorities, develop clear policy narratives, and shape approaches to key policy issues.
  • Build relationships and partnerships with external organizations, including trade associations and civil society organizations, to advance engagement and thought leadership on priority public policy issues.
  • Represent Spotify with policymakers, government officials, industry peers, and other external stakeholders in support of the company’s policy priorities.
